title: Tooltip
description: Hover / focus tooltip — configurable position with auto-flip + Escape to dismiss.

tool.name: mount_tooltip
tool.description: Mount a Tooltip gallery on the canvas.

props.name: content
props.desc: Plain-text tooltip content (use `tooltipContent` snippet for rich content)

props.name: position
props.desc: Preferred side — auto-flips when it would overflow

props.name: delay
props.desc: Hover-in delay in ms (hides are immediate)

props.name: class
props.desc: Extra CSS classes on the wrapper

props.name: tooltipContent
props.desc: Rich tooltip body — overrides `content` when set
